entities.name: Renormalization of QFT
entities.description: Gopal's M.Sc. project on renormalization in quantum electrodynamics.

entities.name: Quantum Electrodynamics
entities.description: QED: the quantum field theory of electrons, positrons and photons.

entities.name: Feynman Diagrams
entities.description: Pictorial rules for computing scattering amplitudes in QED.

entities.name: Compton Scattering
entities.description: Photon-electron scattering; its lab-frame cross section is Klein-Nishina.

entities.name: Bhabha Scattering
entities.description: Electron-positron scattering with t- and s-channel photon exchange.

entities.name: Moller Scattering
entities.description: Electron-electron scattering with t- and u-channel exchange.

entities.name: Pair Production
entities.description: e+ e- -> mu+ mu- through an s-channel photon.

entities.name: Ward-Takahashi Identity
entities.description: Gauge-invariance identity implying Z1 = Z2 in QED.

entities.name: Dimensional Regularization
entities.description: Regularizes loop integrals in n = 4 - eps dimensions; poles appear as 2/eps.

entities.name: Vacuum Polarization
entities.description: One-loop photon self-energy; its pole fixes Z3 and the running of alpha.

entities.name: Electron Self-Energy
entities.description: One-loop correction to the electron propagator giving Z2 and the mass shift.

entities.name: Beta Function
entities.description: Running of the coupling with scale; QED one loop: beta(e) = e^3/(12 pi^2).

entities.name: Running Coupling
entities.description: Coupling that changes with energy scale, e.g. 1/alpha from 137 to ~129 at M_Z.

entities.name: Asymptotic Freedom
entities.description: QCD coupling weakens at high energy while beta0 = 11 - 2nf/3 > 0.

entities.name: qft-renorm-ai
entities.description: Open-source repo turning the M.Sc. renormalization work into SymPy code plus AI experiments.

entities.name: qftlab
entities.description: Python package in qft-renorm-ai that derives QED counterterms symbolically.

entities.name: SymPy
entities.description: Python computer-algebra system.

entities.name: Sparse Regression
entities.description: STLSQ (SINDy-style) regression selecting few terms from a library.

entities.name: Beta0 Rediscovery
entities.description: Sparse regression on noisy alpha_s data recovers beta0 = 11 - 2nf/3; freedom lost at nf ~16.3.

entities.name: LLM + CAS Experiment
entities.description: Benchmark of an LLM alone vs an LLM calling computer-algebra tools on 24 loop tasks.

entities.name: graphwalk-rag
entities.description: Open-source graph RAG: LightRAG build, NetworkX/Neo4j storage, path-walking retrievers.

entities.name: Meet-in-the-Middle Search
entities.description: Bidirectional search: forward from anchors, backward from answer candidates, joined at a midpoint.

entities.name: Answer Candidate Seeding
entities.description: Ranks the anchors' hub-guarded reachable set to propose answer nodes.

entities.name: Hub Guard
entities.description: Never traverses nodes with degree above a threshold, removing generic distractor paths.

entities.name: Cross-Encoder Reranking
entities.description: Scores query-candidate pairs jointly with a local transformer.

entities.name: Guided Walk
entities.description: Document-routed, question-filtered beam walk for long regulatory corpora.

entities.name: Single-First Router
entities.description: Answers single-pass and decomposes the question only on abstention.

entities.name: Query Decomposition
entities.description: Self-ask: resolve the bridge entity, then re-query with it named.

entities.name: Multi-hop QA
entities.description: Questions whose answer is several relations away from what they mention.

entities.name: HotpotQA
entities.description: Public multi-hop QA benchmark; Gopal's graph has 52,474 nodes over 10,000 documents.

entities.name: Multi-hop Accuracy 47% to 53%

entities.name: Router 76.9%

entities.name: 200x Fewer Candidates
